outfit.name: 杜鹃台改良高街制服与绝对领域
outfit.prose: A tailored fitted white school shirt with unfastened top buttons and a loosely tied yellow necktie, layered under a cropped dark navy knit vest. Worn with an ultra-short charcoal pleated skirt, 40D semi-sheer black over-knee stockings, and a buckled leather thigh strap creating a visible soft pinch on the bare thigh.
